svg.title: DorkOS replaceable interfaces
svg.desc: Each row names a caller, its port, and the implementations behind it. A port is a code boundary, not necessarily a network boundary. Dashed edges mark the unregistered Buzz implementation and the sealed-computer runtime, which has no conformance suite. The decision ladder has two production callers since October: heartbeat triage and the space server's post checks.
